translations.web: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand,
translations.bsb: But the worthless are all like thorns raked aside, for they can never be gathered by hand.
translations.kjv: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
